description: A sulfur cube that swallowed dirt goes into a bucket with its sulfur_cube_content, custom name and bucket_entity_data (SulfurCube.saveToBucketTag) and comes out of it with the block again (applyImplicitComponents, loadFromBucketTag) (#183). A gold block marks the released cube with the block, name and bucket data. Only the marks are observed: a cube holding a block is not simulated like Vanilla yet.

actions.command: execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:sulfur_cube,nbt={from_bucket:1b,CustomName:"Cubey",equipment:{body:{id:"minecraft:dirt"}}}] run setblock 0 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
